method: Direct view_image inspection of all five final run-02 PNGs at original resolution.

images.observation: Baseline reference shows the original six compact tabs and existing Proven badges on Lever and Screw.

A clear heading and short invitation lead into six larger station cards. All machine names and observation cues fit. The Screw selection chip, existing Proven badge and outer keyboard focus are separately legible. The six unchanged schematic shapes are distinct and larger.

At 320px in dark mode, all six single-column cards retain readable names and complete observation cues. The selected Screw has an amber border and chip with a separate white outer focus outline. No overlapping or clipped content appears.

At 320px with forced colors, all six schematic shapes remain visible. Black card boundaries and purple selected/focus outlines distinguish the cards, and the Selected marker remains separate from the existing Proven badge.

At 320px with doubled HTML text, the heading, machine names and cues wrap inside tall single-column cards without clipping. Selected and Proven remain separately readable. Card dimensions remain stable across selection after the enlarged styles are applied.

limits: Screenshots crop the complete station chooser; baseline and current desktop images intentionally show their different region heights.
Enlarged text doubles computed HTML font sizes inside the chooser rather than browser zoom; SVG artwork remains unchanged.
Native harness uses real React, THREE and the host module with software WebGL. Forced colors are Chromium emulation; no screen-reader evaluation was performed.
The first native attempt retained two timing-sensitive assertion failures; the second attempt adds animation-frame settling and a stricter applied-font assertion, with unchanged production source.
